route_plan.route_thesis: Use a direct amide disconnection smoke strategy.
route_plan.terminal_rescue_policy: Before accepting advanced terminal, attempt a short mechanistic rollback to simpler credible precursors.

next_actions: explore_site(site_id) if the next site is already known
prompt_brief.language_guidance: Use English for all user-facing planning prose and explanations unless the user explicitly requests another language. Preserve SMILES, schema identifiers, enum values, and exact source quotations unchanged.
quality_guardrails: Rachel supplies structured chemical facts, candidate scaffolds, risks, and challenges; the LLM owns provisional route hypotheses, reaction design, comparison, and final chemistry judgment.
Chemical plausibility and route quality outrank template score, validation convenience, and route depth.

Keep route_plan within these limits: route_thesis 360 chars; route_mode 100; key_disconnections 5 items x 160 chars; preferred_precursor_logic 4 x 180; protect_or_preserve 4 x 160; mode_evidence, strategic_risks, and revision_triggers 5 x 180 each; terminal_rescue_policy 220; revision_reason 160. Rachel rejects an over-limit update and never truncates it.
At route-plan initialization, record the likely route paradigm, evidence, strategic risks, and revision triggers.

Treat local action-space as evidence, not the full retrosynthesis boundary; when it captures only local FGI while core construction remains unresolved, consider revising route_plan or using route_sketch.
Prefer installing reactive temporary handles late when compatible with the route; protection/deprotection must remain explicit tree steps.

Prefer preserving established scaffold topology when routes are comparably credible; any ring construction, opening, or scaffold change still requires explicit mechanistic and atom-source justification.

experience_prompts.one_line: Before the first complex-target plan, classify the route hypothesis instead of jumping directly to a local disconnection.
experience_prompts.action_prompt: Compare late FGI/editing, scaffold assembly, electronic-state strategy, and hybrid routes; write the current choice plus evidence, risks, and revision triggers into route_plan.
experience_prompts.avoid: Do not treat the listed local action-space as the complete retrosynthesis space, and do not let a route-mode decision remain only in hidden reasoning.

experience_prompts.one_line: An active route_plan is the current synthesis thesis; local evidence should support, falsify, enrich, or materially revise it.
experience_prompts.action_prompt: Read route_plan_brief while comparing this site or action. State how the local choice preserves or changes the planned disconnection, precursor logic, sequence, handle timing, scaffold policy, or selectivity strategy.
experience_prompts.avoid: Do not let local template convenience silently replace the recorded route thesis.

experience_prompts.one_line: When a better route emerges or evidence conflicts with the existing plan, make a concise route_plan revision instead of drifting silently.
experience_prompts.action_prompt: Use route_plan(...) to record revision_reason and update the thesis, key disconnections, and structures to preserve before resuming the standard action/sandbox loop.
experience_prompts.avoid: Do not mix the old plan and the new choice in reasoning without updating state.

experience_prompts.one_line: Key atom sources matter more than template names; every new C/N/S/halogen/protecting-group atom needs a source.
experience_prompts.action_prompt: Before commit, state where key C/N/S/halogen/protecting-group atoms come from. For fused-ring rescue, explicitly identify the source of any new C-C bond and whether it comes from tethered atoms, a small molecule, or a named fragment.
experience_prompts.avoid: Do not submit a route where the product gains carbon or a ring bond without a precursor or reagent source.

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: Use a direct amide disconnection smoke strategy.
route_plan_brief.terminal_rescue_policy: Before accepting advanced terminal, attempt a short mechanistic rollback to simpler credible precursors.

self_prompt: Use route_plan in two paths: revision 0 may be a short LLM-owned provisional thesis seed grounded in the target and molecule-level Rachel facts and must use revision_reason="initial"; if that seed was recorded, relevant reaction_sites/explore_site Rachel molecule/site facts should produce an evidence-enriched complete revision 1 plan, while an evidence-first initial call with no prior seed records the complete revision-0 plan directly.

On every later revision, restate the complete current plan because route_plan replaces rather than merges omitted fields; include route_mode, mode evidence, key disconnections, precursor logic, preserve/build decisions, strategic risks, revision triggers, terminal policy, and revision reason.

Revise when evidence changes a recorded substantive claim, including precursor family, sequence, handle timing, preserve/build choice, or selectivity strategy; do not revise for catalyst, reagent, solvent, or template-only changes within the same planned event.
Rachel listed actions and LLM-designed actions are peer executable evidence, not the global plan; use them to support, falsify, enrich, or revise the thesis rather than copying the local action menu.
